name: Miki Wallenberg
source: She’s a clumsy, aloof girl who is overflowing with cuteness and too much energy, which happens to annoy most people around her. Most of her time is spent roaming around the academy trying to find unique and fun made up games to play. Usually resulting in others questioning exactly what’s going on in her mind at times. She and Erika transferred to the school around the same time, which allowed for them to become good friends with one another.
